verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a security scanner, so license detection and policy enforcement in scans is a fair question for this kind of tool. However, the evidence describes only hardcoded-secret detection (passwords, API keys, tokens) in git repos, directories and stdin. Nothing in the pack documents dependency license detection or license policy enforcement.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can detect the licenses of my dependencies and enforce a license policy in scans
